rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for a situation or event that has gone disastrously wrong.

example.english: The whole thing has turned calamitous this time.
example.traditional: 今次成件事搞到大鑊喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 sing4 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 daai6 wok6 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the direct, all-purpose description, especially before a noun such as 災難性嘅風暴.

example.english: This calamitous storm destroyed many homes.
example.traditional: 呢場災難性嘅風暴摧毀咗好多屋企。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6 sing3 ge3 fung1 bou6 ceoi1 wai2 zo2 hou2 do1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when the disastrous aspect is specifically severe losses, damage, casualties, or consequences.

example.english: The fire resulted in calamitous losses.
example.traditional: 今次火災造成慘重損失。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 fo2 zoi1 zou6 sing4 caam2 zung6 syun2 sat1
